title: Carbon Pricing and Inequality: A Normative Perspective
abstract: Despite broad acceptance among economists, carbon taxes face persistent public resistance. We measure the sources and distribution of welfare losses from unexpected European carbon price changes by estimating their impact on consumer prices, labor income, financial wealth, and government transfers.A 1% carbon-policy-induced increase in energy prices leads to an average welfare loss of about 0.5%of a household's three-year consumption, primarily driven by indirect labor-income effects. Younger, poorer, and less educated households, especially in Southern and Eastern Europe, bear a disproportionate burden. These findings suggest public opposition to carbon taxes could stem from legitimate distributional concerns.
abstract_zh: 尽管经济学家普遍认可碳税，但它仍面临持续的公众抵制。我们通过估计欧洲碳价意外变动对消费者价格、劳动收入、金融财富和政府转移支付的影响，衡量了福利损失的来源和分布。由碳政策引起的能源价格上涨1%，平均导致家庭三年消费中约0.5%的福利损失，这主要由间接的劳动收入效应驱动。年轻、较贫穷且受教育程度较低的家庭，尤其是南欧和东欧的家庭，承担了不成比例的负担。这些发现表明，公众对碳税的反对可能源于合理的分配关切。

title: Growth and Degrowth in the Use of Material Resources
abstract: The use of material resources in the US grew strongly in the first part of the twentieth century, before beginning to slowly decline in per-capita terms after 1970. This “degrowth” was widespread, occurring across energy inputs, metals, construction inputs, and biological materials. I show that much of this decline came from material-augmenting technical change, spurred on by high energy prices. There is also a significant portion that is due to slowing goods expenditure with rising incomes. Rising foreign trade and increased intangible investment, however, are largely unimportant. I discuss the possibilities for continued degrowth in material inputs in the coming century.
abstract_zh: 美国物质资源的使用在20世纪上半叶强劲增长，1970年之后则开始以人均计算缓慢下降。这种“去增长”现象十分普遍，涵盖能源投入、金属、建筑投入和生物材料等领域。我表明，这一下降的大部分源于物质增强型技术进步，而高能源价格推动了这一进程。另有相当一部分下降是由于随着收入增长，商品支出放缓所致。然而，对外贸易的扩大和无形投资的增加基本不重要。我讨论了未来一个世纪中物质投入持续去增长的可能性。

title: Growth, Firm Scale, and the Energy Intensity of Production
abstract: We uncover a new mechanism that links growth and a decline in the energy intensity of production, observed globally since 1990. Using microdata from India and a causal research design, we demonstrate that the expenditure share of energy declines steeply with firm scale, due both to physical scaling laws and technology investment. Given the fact that average firm size increases with growth, this scale dependence in energy demand implies that production endogenously becomes less energy-intensive with aggregate growth. We develop a model of this mechanism in general equilibrium, and quantify significant reductions in aggregate energy intensity as low-and middle-income countries (LMICs) like India grow. We conclude with a discussion of the future path of emissions in India.
abstract_zh: 我们揭示了一个将增长与生产能源强度下降联系起来的新机制，自1990年以来，这一现象在全球范围内均有观察到。利用印度的微观数据和因果识别设计，我们证明能源支出份额随企业规模的扩大而急剧下降，这既源于物理尺度规律，也源于技术投资。鉴于平均企业规模随增长而扩大，这种能源需求对规模的依赖意味着，随着总体增长，生产会内生地变得能源密集度更低。我们在一般均衡框架下构建了该机制的模型，并量化了印度等中低收入国家（LMICs）增长过程中总体能源强度的显著下降。最后，我们讨论了印度未来的排放路径。

title: The Intrinsic Valuation of Biodiversity Loss
abstract: We explore the welfare costs of the loss of animal life in a consequentialist total utilitarian framework that incorporates the intrinsic value of living beings through their sentience. Moral philosophy and neuroscience define sentience as the capacity for valenced experience. Observable performance on cognitive tests represents a conservative lower bound on sentience under plausible neuroscientific assumptions. We estimate the relationship between cognition and neuron counts to cardinalize sentience. We collect population and neuron data for a wide range of animal species, and aggregate them into a single welfare measure. Across a wide range of parameters, the aggregate sentience losses of animals in the past half century outstrip the sentience gains to humans from population growth by at least 10,000-fold. Breaking even in welfare terms requires assigning a correspondingly small welfare weight to animals. Including the benefits of economic growth to humans does little to change these overall welfare losses.
abstract_zh: 我们在结果主义的总量功利主义框架中探讨动物生命丧失的福利成本，该框架通过生物的感知能力纳入其内在价值。道德哲学和神经科学将感知能力定义为具有效价的体验能力。在合理的神经科学假设下，认知测试中的可观察表现代表了感知能力的保守下界。我们估计认知与神经元数量之间的关系，以使感知能力可量化。我们收集了大量动物物种的种群和神经元数据，并将其汇总为单一的福利指标。在广泛的参数范围内，过去半个世纪动物的总体感知损失至少比人口增长给人类带来的感知收益大10,000倍。要在福利层面实现盈亏平衡，需要赋予动物相应地极小的福利权重。纳入经济增长给人类带来的收益，对总体福利损失几乎没有改变。

title: Are Inflationary Shocks Regressive? A Feasible Set Approach
The Economic Impacts of Clean Energy
abstract: In this paper we assess the economic impacts of moving to a renewable-dominated grid in the United States. We use projections of capital costs to develop price bounds on future wholesale power prices at the local geographic level. We then use a class of spatial general equilibrium models to estimate the effect on wages and output of prices falling below these bounds in the medium term. Power prices fall anywhere between 20 percent and 80 percent, depending on local solar resources, leading to an aggregate real wage gain of 2–3 percent. Over the longer term, we show how moving to clean energy represents a qualitative change in the aggregate growth process, alleviating the "resource drag" that has slowed recent productivity growth in the United States.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了美国向以可再生能源为主的电网转型的经济影响。我们利用资本成本的预测，为未来地方地理层面的批发电价建立价格区间。随后，我们使用一类空间一般均衡模型，估计在中期电价跌至这些区间以下时对工资和产出的影响。电价下降幅度在20%至80%之间，取决于当地的太阳能资源，并带来2%至3%的总体实际工资增长。从更长期来看，我们说明了向清洁能源转型代表了总体增长过程的质变，缓解了近期拖慢美国生产率增长的“资源拖累”（resource drag）。

title: The Returns to Big City Experience: Evidence From Refugees in Denmark
